<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a byproduct of [[farming]] and is used to produce [[peat]] and [[maggot]]s, or broken down via [[alchemy]]. Alternatively, it can be purchased from the [[Shepherd]].

==Alchemy==
Crop waste is decomposable to powder at the [[Alchemy mill]]. Having unlocked [[Anatomy and Alchemy (Tech Tree)|Master of Alchemy]] will produce one additional reagent.

|}
